Risk: Store managers and advisors cannot attend workshops and UAT during busy trading periods
Response: Book sessions outside peak hours; use store champions; record short demos

Risk: Store stock data is less accurate than needed for click & collect
Response: Measure accuracy in discovery (A06); add a stock-check step before confirming orders

Risk: Integration across app, order management, point of sale and logistics takes longer than planned
Response: Specify interfaces by Gate 2; agree release windows early; spike risky interfaces first

Risk: Privacy requirements found late delay the pilot
Response: Privacy lead in requirements workshops; privacy checklist at Gates 2 and 3

Risk: Online and store teams disagree on revenue attribution
Response: Finance-led workshop in week 8; options paper; decision at Gate 2

Risk: Scope grows (for example, Fashion or exchanges) before the pilot
Response: Out-of-scope list; change control; park ideas in the phase 2 backlog

Risk: Key subject matter expert leaves or moves
Response: Record decisions and models on the wiki; name a deputy for each theme

Risk: Some brands' selective distribution terms limit store collection of their products
Response: Check brand terms in discovery; exclude products by rule if needed

Risk: Logistics partner interface cannot cancel reverse pickups automatically
Response: Manual cancellation fallback for the pilot

Risk: Customers do not notice or trust the new options
Response: Clear app messages, store signage and launch offers; measure in pilot surveys
